title: BarConfig
description: Status bar configuration (the Bar module reads it; default disabled).

enabled.description: Whether the status bar is enabled.

height.description: Height of the status bar in pixels. Zero is preserved, not replaced.

layout.description:
Which widgets the Bar shows, in three ordered zones: `start` (leading
edge), `center` (centered on the Bar) and `end` (trailing edge).
An entry is a widget name (`spaces`, `media`, `weather`, `cpu`,
`battery`, `keep_awake`, `wifi`, `clock`) or a table with `widget`, an
optional unique `id` (ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`) and that
widget's options: `clock` takes `show_date` and `show_seconds` (default
true) and `hour_cycle` (`"h23"` or `"h12"`, default `"h23"`); `cpu`
takes `temperature_alert` (1 to 150 degrees Celsius, default 85). A
widget may appear more than once. Without `[layout]` the default below
is used; a zone left out of a present `[layout]` is empty.

Example:
  start = ["spaces"]
  center = ["media"]
  end = ["weather", { widget = "cpu", temperature_alert = 90 }, { widget = "clock", id = "main_clock", show_seconds = false }]

padding.description: Padding around the status bar in pixels. Zero is preserved, not replaced.

BarEntryClockOptions.description:
The keys of an entry table besides `widget`: an optional `id` and the
widget's options, flat.

id.description:
A stable identity for this item: ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`,
unique across all zones. Omitted, the widget name is used (then
`<name>_2`, `<name>_3`, ... for repeats, in file order).

show_date.description: Whether the date is shown before the time.

BarEntryCpuOptions.description:
The keys of an entry table besides `widget`: an optional `id` and the
widget's options, flat.

id.description:
A stable identity for this item: ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`,
unique across all zones. Omitted, the widget name is used (then
`<name>_2`, `<name>_3`, ... for repeats, in file order).

temperature_alert.description:
The temperature, in degrees Celsius, at which the CPU item shows its
alert (1 to 150).

The keys of an entry table besides `widget`: an optional `id` and the
widget's options, flat.

id.description:
A stable identity for this item: ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`,
unique across all zones. Omitted, the widget name is used (then
`<name>_2`, `<name>_3`, ... for repeats, in file order).

BarLayoutConfig.description:
The three ordered Bar zones. A missing `[layout]` is the default
arrangement; a zone missing from a present `[layout]` is empty.

center.description: Items centered on the Bar, in order.

end.description: Items aligned to the trailing edge, in order.

start.description: Items aligned to the leading edge, in order.

BarLayoutEntry.description:
One layout entry: a widget name, or a table with `widget`, an optional
`id` and that widget's options.

anyOf.description: A widget name; its id is generated and its options are the defaults.
A widget with an optional explicit id and options.

BarLayoutEntryTable.description: The table form of a layout entry, one shape per widget.

BarWidgetKind.description: A widget the Bar can place in a layout zone.

HourCycle.description: Whether the clock counts hours 0 to 23 or 1 to 12 with a day period.

WeatherConfig.description: Weather settings for the status bar.

api_keys.description:
Path to an environment file containing API keys (for example
`VISUAL_CROSSING_API_KEY=...`).

The value is trimmed. `~` and `~/...` expand to the home directory,
absolute paths are used as written and anything else is relative to the
configuration directory. Environment variables and shell syntax are not
expanded, and the process working directory is never used.

default_location.description:
Default location for weather data, used when native macOS Location is
unavailable, denied or times out. Can be a city name, address, or
coordinates.

precise_location.description:
Whether weather asks macOS for a precise location.

`false` (the default) requests an approximate, kilometer-level location
and accepts the approximate-location choice the user made in macOS
Location settings. `true` requests the best accuracy and, only when macOS
reports approximate access and the app bundle declares a purpose, asks at
most once per run for temporary full accuracy. Neither setting re-asks
for Location access once macOS has recorded a decision.

refresh_interval.description:
Minutes between automatic weather refreshes, from 5 to 1440 (24 hours).
Applies after a configuration reload without restarting Bar.

oneOf.description: Use Visual Crossing when an API key file is configured, otherwise Open Meteo.
Force Visual Crossing (requires an API key file).
Use Open Meteo (free, no API key required).
